actor: Employee or contractor with legitimate access
threat_event: Sensitive data copied to an unauthorized destination
attack_path: Overbroad access → bulk query/export → transfer to personal or external destination
current_control_gap: Limited visibility into unusual access and bulk data movement
recommended_controls: Least privilege; DLP; UEBA; egress controls; data minimization; tested incident response
kri: Sensitive-data export alerts investigated within SLA
evidence_status: Illustrative assumption; validate with bank data

threat_event: Unauthorized change or release of a high-value payment instruction
attack_path: Privileged session → change beneficiary/payment data → bypass or misuse approval → release
current_control_gap: Potential concentration of privileged capability and approval authority
recommended_controls: PAM; just-in-time access; dual authorization; independent reconciliation; immutable session logs
kri: Percentage of high-risk payment changes with independent approval
evidence_status: Illustrative assumption; validate with bank data

asset: Customer records, reports, and internal documents
threat_event: Sensitive information sent to wrong recipient or stored in an unsafe location
attack_path: Routine workflow → misaddressed message / unsafe sharing → external exposure
current_control_gap: Preventive guardrails may not cover every channel or workflow
recommended_controls: DLP policy tuning; recipient confirmation; secure sharing defaults; targeted training
kri: Repeat policy violations and confirmed misdelivery rate
evidence_status: Illustrative assumption; validate with bank data

asset: Customer data, transaction workflows, and internal access pathways
threat_event: Two or more parties coordinate to bypass controls or exfiltrate data
stride: Spoofing; tampering; information disclosure; elevation of privilege
attack_path: Shared knowledge or access → split duties across actors → evade single-control monitoring
current_control_gap: Individual-level monitoring may miss coordinated activity
recommended_controls: Separation of duties; independent approvals; contractor lifecycle controls; cross-account analytics; speak-up channels
kri: High-risk incompatible-role conflicts unresolved past SLA
evidence_status: Illustrative assumption; validate with bank data

actor: Privileged insider seeking to conceal another action
asset: Audit logs, monitoring infrastructure, and transaction evidence
threat_event: An insider alters, disables, or deletes records needed to detect or investigate misconduct
attack_path: Privileged access → logging configuration or retention change → evidence gap
current_control_gap: Log administration may not be sufficiently separated from system administration
recommended_controls: Immutable centralized logging; separate log-admin roles; alert on logging changes; tested evidence retention
kri: Critical systems with tamper-resistant log coverage
evidence_status: Illustrative assumption; validate with bank data
